caption: The drawing depicts a figurine in the shape of a bulldog sitting upright on a rectangular pedestal. The bulldog is brown with variations in tone to indicate texture and shading, and it wears a spiked collar around its neck. The bulldog's mouth is open, and its eyes are hollow, giving a sense of depth. The base of the pedestal is a dark brown color, and on one side, the words "BULLDOG BANK" are inscribed in red capital letters. The background of the drawing is plain and cream-colored, emphasizing the subject. In the lower right corner, the name "Pearl Forell" is hand-written in pencil. The entire composition is centered, with the bulldog bank occupying most of the visual space.
title: Toy Bank
